summary:
Etsy

The tax man has launched a new crackdown on “side hustlers” who make money from selling items online.

From the New Year, millions of people using platforms such as eBay, Vinted, Etsy and Depop will be under much greater scrutiny and could be forced to pay tax on their sales as a result.

Firms are now obliged to collect and share details of transactions with the tax authorities – paving the way for HMRC to snuff out tax dodgers earning more than £1,000 from online sales.
